_note: divebooker.com hull slug -> this site's boat id. Hand-maintained, like data/padi_aliases.json and for the same reason: nothing automatic survives vessel names. `tools/match_divebooker.py` states the rule the first ten were confirmed by -- the vessel name divebooker states, normalised, equals one of ours -- and applies it to the 92 hulls the whole-fleet read of 2026-09-20 found: 47 pairs, every one of them a name match. Two more are a person's: `sea-serpent-glorious-miss-nouran` and `sea-serpent-serena-dreams` are our `ss-` hulls, and the warrant is the operator -- both are Sea Serpent Fleet, as are the four Sea Serpent hulls the rule paired outright. The 35 hulls left unmapped are boats this site does not carry; unmapped is a safe answer, because `promote` names an unmapped hull rather than guessing at it. A slug that stops matching must be re-checked by a person, never re-derived.
